prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” AI marketing agency in Los Angeles—it depends on whether you need AI-powered campaigns, AI search visibility, or broader digital marketing.

**For a full-service agency with AI visibility work, Thrive Internet Marketing Agency is a reasonable starting point.** Its Los Angeles offering includes SEO and other digital marketing services, and it reports case-study results in organic leads and traffic from AI platforms. Those results are agency-reported, so ask for examples relevant to your industry and verify how they were measured.

If your priority is specifically **showing up in ChatGPT, Gemini, or other AI search results**, compare specialists such as **LAv1** and **Earned Media** as well. Before choosing, ask each agency for a recent client reference, a clear measurement plan, and a proposal tied to your business goals—not just promises of “AI rankings.”
